name: away_with_active_natvent_transition__whf
description: [whole-house-fan twin of golden 'away_with_active_natvent_transition'; Issue #1193] Hot day: nat-vent running at home. User leaves (occupancy_away) at 15:00. Production only changes the setpoint to setback_cool — nat-vent continues running. There is no explicit nat-vent exit event on occupancy transition. WHF specifics: the away setback is refused while the fan runs (rule 2); the deferral and the later landing of the setback are pinned by away_setback_deferred_until_whf_stops_and_window_closes__whf.
source: Issue #1193: whole-house-fan twin of golden 'away_with_active_natvent_transition' (pre-#1140 version, fan configured). The golden is locked and now asserts the no-fan 'paused' result.
notes: Production handle_occupancy_away() does NOT deactivate nat-vent. It only changes the setpoint.
Nat-vent continues until a natural exit condition fires: outdoor rises, comfort floor hit, threshold exceeded.
This scenario verifies: (1) away setback is applied, (2) nat-vent state is NOT prematurely exited.
The assertion that nat-vent is still active after away transition documents production behavior.
Previously this scenario incorrectly asserted nat_vent_exit at the away transition — that was
whole_house_fan twin (Issue #1193): with a whole-house fan configured, an open window with usable outdoor air runs the fan and suppresses HVAC (rule 2: fan and HVAC never together).

events.note: Hot-day classification at home (classifier derives cool for a hot day)
Window opens: nat-vent activates (outdoor 65F < indoor 73.5F, below threshold 77F)
User leaves. Production: only setpoint changes to setback_cool. Nat-vent continues.

assertions.reason: [whole-house-fan twin] sensor_open: outdoor=65F < indoor=73.5F, indoor > comfort_heat=70F, threshold=77F — nat-vent activates

[whole-house-fan twin] Rule 2: the occupant leaves at 15:00 while the whole-house fan runs; the away setback write is refused (hvac_write_blocked_whf_active). The fan keeps cooling the empty house for free; the setback is deferred, not lost.

[whole-house-fan twin] After away transition, nat-vent state flag must still be True. Production does not exit nat-vent on occupancy change — only the setpoint changes. Reads the live engine _natural_vent_active attribute.

verdict.summary: [whole-house-fan twin] Away transition changes setpoint only; nat-vent continues running (production behavior)
verdict.observed_behavior: occupancy_away fires -> hvac_write_blocked_whf_active (setback_cool 79F refused while the fan runs, rule 2); nat-vent flag remains active
verdict.expected_behavior: Leaving home while nat-vent is active: only setpoint changes. No explicit nat-vent exit event. Nat-vent exits naturally when outdoor conditions change.
